types.description: Murrelektronik MCVO 28501 proportional amplifier; 18-32 V DC supply, 0-10 V unipolar command, PWM valve output; exact eleven-clamp field interface, partial return commoning scope

document.title: Murrelektronik MCVO-Proportional amplifier 24 V / 2.5 A — exact 28501 operating instructions, English file 28501_ina_en_11.pdf in manufacturer archive
document.pages: English pp.1-2; p.2 section 3 exact eleven-clamp layout and detailed circuit; section 4 alternative setpoint wiring

modelingNotes: Exact legacy order 28501 is established by its own manufacturer instruction and historical catalog physical p.6/printed 1.4.6 right-hand 24 V column. Source make Murr and order 28501 are retained; manufacturer name is Murrelektronik. The manufacturer old/new index, Audin mirror physical p.3/printed 1.11.3, maps 28501 to 7000-31261-0000000; this proposal uses the exact 28501 manual for its physical interface rather than transferring a generic modern photograph.

Exact manual p.2 front layout: upper row PE, 2-, 1+; middle row PE, 24V, 0, 0; lower row 0, IN, 10V, 0. There are eleven field clamps, including four distinct printed 0 clamps and two printed PE clamps. PE-in/PE-out and 0-supply-a/b/0-signal-left/right are library aliases for the groups/positions shown in that drawing, not additional stamped text. OUT and unpolarized 1/2 from the simplified catalog schematic are superseded here by exact layout marks 10V, 1+, 2-.

Supply 24V accepts 18-32 V DC, with maximum 10% ripple and 2200 uF buffer capacitance per ampere of load; approximately 10 s start-up, own consumption at most 50 mA. Observe supply polarity even though protection is specified. No exact 24 V input scalar or whole-device voltage/current scalar is assigned to a supported range.

IN is a positive unipolar 0-10 V DC command, input resistance at least 200 kOhm. Physical 10V is a generated +10 V reference, tolerance+/-5%, maximum 5 mA at 24 V supply; do not externally feed it. The nominal 10 V scalar describes this actual reference output only.

Manual p.2 section 4 alternatives: external command uses IN and the illustrated right-hand lower 0 with 10V open; an external potentiometer of at least 2 kOhm uses 10V, IN (wiper) and the illustrated left-hand lower 0; internal parameter setting uses an installer-supplied IN-to-10V jumper. Reference 10V is optional. The application jumper is not factory continuity.

Valve output 1+/2- is polarity marked and PWM current controlled for a single-acting solenoid. Output voltage follows operating supply minus at most 1.2 V, pulse width modulated; it is not a fixed 24 V source. Inductive current capability 2.5 A, Imax setting 0.2 A to 2.5 A +10% in the 2022 manuals, factory 1 A; Imin approximately 10 mA factory, adjustable to 30-40% of Imax. These remain conditional notes, not nominal output/current scalars.

Factory conductive paths retained in conformance: the supply 0 pair is explicitly joined in the exact 28501 historical catalog circuit, and the two PE endpoints have a direct line in the exact manual p.2. Function or symbol metadata does not create these net joins; fixture/promotion must materialize the conformance fixed links.

Partial return continuity: the manual layout shows four 0 clamps but its block diagram collapses return occurrences to one 0 reference; the historical diagram routes a control 0 into the converter separately. Individual bonds between the two control 0 clamps and the supply 0 pair are not explicitly traced, so no further return links are asserted. This omission is not proof of electrical isolation and prevents claiming complete internal connectivity.

Manual p.2 places R_sens between 0 and 2-. Do not author a fixed path from 2- to 0 across that resistor. Likewise no permanent path from 24V to 1+, from 1+ to 2-, from 10V to 24V or from 10V to IN is implied through reverse-polarity protection, PWM electronics, conversion or recovery diode. Detailed electronic transfer behavior is not simulated by this field-interface model.

Required 24V and representative 0-supply-a express powered use; the fixed supply 0 pair permits using the duplicate return. Requiring PE-in is explicit library policy for modeled protective bonding, not a manufacturer assertion that this exact clamp is universally wired. An internal PE link can satisfy a presence diagnostic without proving an external bond. Remaining clamps, including 10V and alternate control returns, are application-dependent and not universally required.

Front Imin/Imax and underside f/tR are adjustment potentiometers, not field terminals; the status indicator is internal. Frequency range 40 Hz-5% to 400 Hz+10%, factory 400 Hz; equal ramp-up/down adjustment 0.2 s+20% to 10 s+20%, factory minimum. Short-circuit protection is temporary, at most 2 s; overtemperature/overload shutdown is documented, not unlimited short-circuit capability.

Revision differences remain unresolved: 2022 EN/DE manuals give Imax minimum 0.2 A; historical catalog gives 0.02 A +20%. Manual ambient -25 to +60 C differs from catalog/current -20 to +60 C; manual dimension tuple 75 x 85 x 22.5 mm differs from catalog 75 x 22.5 x 102 mm and dimension labels. Do not silently harmonize these into one exact specification. Manual gives IP 20 and 1.5 mm² clamp connection without a detailed conductor preparation/count table.

Coverage is partial despite the established eleven field clamps: individual return bonds, any rail bonding contact and mating contacts exposed by unplugging/disassembly are not exhaustively documented. No automatic DIN-rail bond or hidden pin inventory is invented. Generic interface/earth symbols depict the bounded field functions.
Presentation uses existing load, source, terminal, earth and interface symbols for field functions. It does not reproduce the internal PWM, amplifier, conversion or sensing circuit.

connectionCoverage.notes: Exact 28501 manual p.2 establishes eleven assembled field clamps, including both lower control 0 positions and polarized 1+/2-. The supply 0 pair and PE pair have evidence-backed fixed paths. Full four-return commoning and disassembled mating/rail-bond inventory are not established; missing return links do not imply galvanic isolation. PWM/converter/sensing electronics are functional abstractions, with no fixed net joins through them.

PE-out.description: Printed PE, upper valve row left; linked to middle-row PE-in. Alias names the field-clamp group.

2-.description: Printed 2-, upper valve row middle: negative PWM valve terminal. R_sens separates it from the 0 reference; no fixed return short.

1+.description: Printed 1+, upper valve row right: positive PWM valve terminal. Output is supply dependent, not fixed 24 V.

PE-in.description: Printed PE, middle supply row left; linked to upper-row PE-out. Required by explicit library bonding policy; external bonding is not proved by the internal link.

24V.description: Printed 24V, middle supply row second: positive 18-32 V DC operating supply, subject to ripple/buffer conditions.

0-supply-a.description: Printed 0, middle supply row third: first supply return. Alias distinguishes it from three other 0 clamps; fixed to 0-supply-b.

0-supply-b.description: Printed 0, middle supply row fourth: second supply return, fixed to 0-supply-a.

0-signal-left.description: Printed 0, lower control row left: reference used by manual external-potentiometer example. Its individual commoning with other 0 clamps remains unmodeled.

IN.description: Printed IN, lower control row second: unipolar 0-10 V command. See alternative external-command/potentiometer/installer-jumper arrangements.

10V.description: Printed 10V, lower control row third: optional generated +10 V reference, +/-5%, maximum 5 mA at 24 V supply; never externally feed.

0-signal-right.description: Printed 0, lower control row right: reference used by manual external-voltage example. Its individual commoning with other 0 clamps remains unmodeled.
